```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    name: Setup Copilot Environment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart SDK
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Setup Flutter SDK
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies for tool
        run: |
          cd tool
          dart pub get

      - name: Install dependencies for marionette_mcp
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart pub get

      - name: Install dependencies for marionette_flutter
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_flutter
          flutter pub get

      - name: Configure Dart Workspace
        run: |
          # Create root pubspec.yaml with workspace definition
          cat > pubspec.yaml << EOF
          name: marionette_mcp_workspace
          workspace:
            - packages/marionette_flutter
            - packages/marionette_mcp
            - example
            - tool
          EOF

          # Add resolution: workspace to all package pubspecs
          find . -name "pubspec.yaml" -not -path "./pubspec.yaml" -exec sed -i '1i resolution: workspace' {} \;

      - name: Run dart pub get for workspace
        run: dart pub get
```
